selection_exposure: POST_HOC_EXPOSURE: before preregistering, inspected Atlas batch 0020 (which claims 20 IC runs), CURRENT subsection, IC04, IC15, IC19, IC20 and IC23 results; cannot present discovery of Atlas entries as prospective. This cycle audits the remaining matrix and cross-checks against current status without claiming independent empirical confirmation.

A.question: Do all 20 historical IC04-IC23 have individually retrievable prereg and result artifacts consistent with an Atlas 0020 run record, and do present PFL claims preserve NO VOTAN and old-baseline restrictions?

B.H1: Historical IC04–IC23 are present in GitHub and structurally represented by Atlas 0020, with limitations correctly demarcated.
B.H0: One or more pairs or run ids are absent/mismatched, so Atlas overstates traceability.
B.H_other: All pairs exist but their content is not substantively complete or external execution remains unverified.

C.discriminant: Fetch each of 20 prereg/result pairs from the same HEAD or SHA-pinned baseline. Parse JSON, check cycle identifiers and unique Atlas run ids. Compare NO VOTAN audit and T007 report, surface any incorrect pending state. All failures retained, not repaired silently.

D.instrument: GitHub connector SHA-pinned file retrieval; in-process JavaScript JSON checks; preserve exact path and missing records. No checkout or native Python claimed.

E.acceptance: Record 20 pair presence, parse status, run references, mismatches, and any post-hoc limitations; results cannot promote scientific grades, gates or source authenticity.

F.adversarial: A JSON file existing is not proof it was preregistered before running; a run.add existing is not proof the experiment happened. Compare selected historical statements and note provenance of externally reported tests.

G.external_independence: Not available in this static audit; not a scientific confirmation nor clean-clone replay.

H.update: Retain negative outcomes and separate provenance/registered-document completeness from empirical claims.

J.rule: If all structural references exist, close documentary QA and STOP_R5 for repeated bookkeeping; if missing, specify exact repair and request guarded local work. Do not merge main, publish personal originals or run CI.
